title: Private Party Bus Wine Tour - Napa or Sonoma!
includes: Mercedes Party Bus & Party Bus Driver/Guide
Tasting Fees (Many wineries have free tastings, we can take you to those if you prefer) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our Napa/Sonoma Wine Tasting Party Bus Tour is a must-do for anyone in the Bay Area-- that's including locals!

Take a private wine tour to the vineyards you want to visit. No canned, hokey destinations or outside tour guests on your ride. Spend as long as you want at each winery, grab lunch in an array of beautiful locations, and head home with our totally custom wine tour service.

Not into planning, but still want a great experience? No problem! Our driver can help you build your plan.

NOTE: A classic wine tour is possible in 6 hours. If you choose to extend your journey (to spend more time somewhere or go to another destination), you will need to pay an additional hourly rate to the service provider at time of service.
